metrics.exact_inputs: Exact token IDs, masks, weights, initial and per-step noise, and sigmas under same scalar dtype/library version.

strong.human_review: No meaningful composition/face/hand/pose/object drift. No automatic crop/alignment/color adjustment permitted.

metrics.exact_output: torch.equal on final latent and equality of uncompressed RGB arrays; matching lossless file hashes not required.
metrics.rule: Thresholds are proposed release criteria fixed by this spec, not empirical results. No retrospective relaxation after failed tests.

tests.case: Spec JSON roundtrip / schema / canonical hash
tests.variants: Float zero normalization; absent/zero/false/null separated; reordered object keys
tests.acceptance: Same semantic config produces the same config_hash; raw infotext remains byte-preserved after defined transport decoding.
Valid uint64 text roundtrips; overflow/reseed sentinel rejected before generation.

tests.variants: Clip Skip absent; ENSD absent; version label without commit; unknown generation keys
tests.acceptance: No absent=>zero/default silently. Inferred behavioral settings require acknowledgment; unknown-affecting fields block strict.

tests.variants: Module ordering swapped; duplicate basenames; short hash collision; duplicate LoRA declaration
tests.acceptance: Resolve by inspected asset family/role, never Module N position or fuzzy first hit. No double loading.

tests.variants: Commas/colons/quotes/CRLF/underscore/Unicode; duplicate Beta aliases
tests.acceptance: Preserve prompt content; decode transport once; conflicting aliases block.

tests.case: All registered scheduler names and Automatic resolution
tests.acceptance: Registry parse coverage only. Compare meaningful pairs with pinned Forge oracle; nonapplicable pairs must reject, not fallback.

tests.variants: discard requested off/on; mandatory-discard sampler; duplicate Beta timestep; min/max/rho; s_tmax=0
tests.acceptance: Exactly equal float32 CPU sigma vectors for supported combinations. Preserve actual length, not forced steps+1.

tests.variants: eta, ENSD, s_noise, churn, SGM per sampler and predictor
tests.acceptance: Applicable settings follow pinned call graph; nonapplicable values retained and explicitly reported as not_applied.
Bit-identical per-image draws/state snapshots with pinned source. No global RNG writes.

tests.case: Noise bundle cache and branch reuse
tests.variants: Same bundle consumed twice, interleaved consumers, cancel/retry
tests.acceptance: Same first/step noise on each run. Input bundle is immutable; each sampler owns its generator.

tests.acceptance: STRONG; CPU unit tests alone do not certify GPU model execution.

tests.acceptance: RNG exact; each same-batching cross-UI pair STRONG. Different batch shape is not assumed bit-identical.

tests.variants: Frozen initial latent; Euler/Simple; denoise.5; scaled/exact
tests.acceptance: Compare sampling from identical latent first. End-to-end image/VAE encode parity is a separate assertion.

tests.variants: Requested1/2/4; same model/TE
tests.acceptance: Forge outputs/conditioning unchanged; Compat effective clip_skip=null and last-layer strategy, not forced -2/-4.

tests.variants: Weighted/plain/empty prompts; all four emphasis labels
tests.acceptance: Compare Qwen tokens/mask, T5 IDs/weights, pre-adapter and post-adapter outputs; preserve Forge-specific semantics, including unusual BREAK behavior.

tests.variants: Record actual embedding, Qwen, adapter dtypes before/after LoRA
tests.acceptance: No dtype override on shared tensors. Declared dtype not actually applied must fail, not count as matched.

tests.variants: Original Forge infotext as exact prompt; same model+Turbo LoRA; do not reuse slightly different Comfy negative prompt
tests.acceptance: Generate a NEW lossless reference pair. Uploaded compressed results are observational regression only.

tests.variants: Same Euler/Simple flow predictor
tests.acceptance: No extra sqrt(1+sigma^2) applied in flow branch; oracle-matching no-op.
Correct selected hidden state and final norm; compare same weights/precision.

tests.variants: Construct prompts at tokenizer lengths74/75/76 and149/150/151; commas near backtrack20; BREAK
tests.acceptance: Token/chunk equality exact; one representative boundary prompt rendered after CPU pass.

tests.variants: Euler/Simple, same initial noise
tests.acceptance: Reference noise scaling and final latent/image meet STRONG for both settings.

tests.variants: Requested1/2/4
tests.acceptance: Effective hidden selection=max(requested,2); 1/2 same; pooled output from correct path.

tests.variants: Different L/G token lengths; non-square size; nonzero crop; explicit original/target
tests.acceptance: L/G concatenation, padding, pooled vector, H/W ordering and crop/target components match reference.

tests.variants: Empty/nonempty negative × zero_empty_negative false/true
tests.acceptance: Zeroing follows pinned Forge option; nonempty prompt not accidentally zeroed.

tests.variants: Fresh process: core-only vs extension installed-unused
tests.acceptance: No pip/network, no global function replacement, no RNG/state writes, no latent interception.

tests.variants: Success/cancel/error with two branched consumers
tests.acceptance: Shared MODEL/CLIP weights, options/hooks and all default RNG states unchanged by extension-owned code.

tests.variants: A=baseline without extension; B=installed-unused; C=after Compat generation and error; fixed native workflow
tests.acceptance: Native success, full nested streams intact, no queue residue. Bit parity required where native self-repeat is bit-stable; otherwise baseline validity must be resolved first.

tests.variants: Synthetic OOM; foreign MODEL; nested latent; unknown patch chain
tests.acceptance: No automatic tiled sampling or lowering size/steps/dtype; fail or explicitly unqualified exploratory report.

tests.variants: Three actual Forge WebP, three Comfy WebP; PNG/JPEG synthetic equivalents; odd RIFF chunk; UTF16 BOM cases
tests.acceptance: Correct extraction; native workflow wins over infotext; originals remain unchanged.

tests.variants: Forge image on canvas with integration on; integration off; JSON/video/native Comfy files
tests.acceptance: Only matching Forge metadata handled. Valid new workflow in separate tab; no existing graph destruction; unsupported files delegate once.

tests.variants: Bad TIFF offsets, cycles, invalid JSON, duplicate conflicting fields, size limits, missing nodes/assets
tests.acceptance: Visible bounded error, no arbitrary eval/exec/import/download/path traversal, no partial graph replacement.

tests.variants: Save/load browser restart, cache hit, branch duplication; seed >2^53
tests.acceptance: Spec values/provenance/hash preserved; no dependence on live Python objects serialized to JSON.
